content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DTU Research Intern Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Delhi Technological University (DTU) for a project-based research position in collaboration with Koshika Foundation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Research Intern under the CCDR project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Intern position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Intern post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for DTU Research Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications via email is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through email by sending their compiled application PDF to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Intern post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed or be pursuing B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in CSE/IT/Software Engineering/AI/Data Science/ECE/Mathematics and Computing/Biomedical Engineering with a minimum of 60% marks, or MCA with a minimum of 70% marks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Intern post is 25 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India or DTU norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the consolidated salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 15,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DTU Research Intern?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications based on eligibility and relevant experience, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of Delhi Technological University?
faq.answer: You can visit the official DTU website at dtu.ac.in for more details and updates regarding the recruitment notification.
